key_insight: CAMEO learns shared multimodal representations from small, partially paired datasets, outperforming CLIP-like contrastive approaches when paired data are scarce.
clinical_relevance: The framework could support biomedical research linking pathology images with gene expression when matched samples are limited, but clinical utility is not established.
method: Learns shared representations with minimal paired samples.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covered pathology niche classification and cell type composition prediction; the authors also report releasing an annotated image–gene expression dataset spanning three organs.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative performance estimates or evidence of clinical validation.
paper_title: Learning Multimodal Representations from Partially Paired, Small-Scale Data
